en: A monochrome historic street scene showing several multi‑story stone buildings with steep tiled roofs, likely in an old European town. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stand and walk along a cobblestone street between the buildings. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Reval and specifically the cathedral school (Domschule). Publisher information is printed in small text along the bottom edge.
